nodes.label: Ottoman War Council Planning Meeting
nodes.rationale: AI-generated cinematic painterly image depicting a group of bearded Ottoman officials/advisors wearing red fez-style headwear (kavuk), seated around a dark wooden table in an ornate candlelit chamber. A large map is spread across the table alongside books, bound documents, and a lit candle in a brass holder; a crystal chandelier hangs overhead and a curtained window is visible in the background. The composition (map + advisors in deliberation) strongly evokes a war council/strategy session, consistent with the project's theme of Mehmed II's preparations for the Conquest of Istanbul (1453).
